intermediate.name: Ponte in Valtellina
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Ponte in Valtellina (127.2 km)

story: Two riders broke away early, but after the first climb at 70 km, Pogacar gained time bonuses in the sprints and thinned the peloton. He caught and dropped Dversnes, then rode solo for the final 69 km. Behind, Carapaz and Bagioli broke away to claim 2nd and 3rd places.
